payload.title: Fail closed before zero-budget optimizer dispatch
payload.description:
The portfolio coordinator currently relies on the public run validator to reject a nonpositive optimizer budget after a human response. The durable child launch-spec boundary does not independently reject a nonpositive budget. Add an early coordinator gate and defense-in-depth launch validation.

Feature: Zero-budget portfolio safety

Scenario: Approved response cannot enter run validation
  Given a portfolio run has a zero optimizer cost budget
  And a valid human response approves an exact target
  When the portfolio coordinator resumes
  Then it does not invoke the optimization run validator
  And it does not construct or dispatch any optimizer child
  And it publishes an explicit non-launch outcome

Scenario: Launch boundary rejects a nonpositive budget
  Given an internal caller supplies a target that appears accepted
  And the optimizer launch limits contain a nonpositive cost budget
  When the durable launch specification is built
  Then the request fails closed before any Procedure or Task is created

Scenario: Positive approved budgets remain unchanged
  Given a fresh approved target and strictly positive explicit limits
  When the coordinator resumes
  Then the existing validation and durable child lifecycle remain unchanged
